info.description: Backend API for the Discipline productivity app
info.title: Discipline API

post.description: Creates a new user account with role "admin". Only accessible by admins.

get.description: Proxies request to the Python analytics microservice securely using the authenticated user's ID.

parameters.description: Report range (week or month, defaults to week)
parameters.name: range

get.description: Heatmap, weekday scores, deep-work slots and distraction trend over the last N days, computed by the analytics service.

post.description: Proxies request to Python to generate a weekly schedule based on user's past habits.

Authenticates a user and returns a JWT token. Failures are throttled per (email, IP) with a progressive delay (429 + Retry-After) and per IP; after 3 failures for an email within 15 minutes, a Turnstile token is required (401 with captchaRequired).
Revokes every token issued to the authenticated user
Creates a new user account with role "user" and returns a JWT token

get.description: "Today" is the user's local date. checkin is null until done or skipped; defaults prefill the sleep times.

put.description: Creates or replaces the check-in for the user's local date (editable the same day). Send {"skipped": true} to skip. With madeAt, a check-in queued offline counts for the local day it was made.

get.description: Planned/done minutes and focus-score components for today in the user's time zone, computed by the analytics service.
Ids of the features switched on with FEATURE_<id>=true on the server. Anything not listed is off.

put.description: Updates the authenticated user's name, email, and/or password. Changing email or password requires oldPassword.
The client makes the id (UUID); sending it again stores nothing new.

get.description: Returns a motivational quote. Cached for 2-3 hours, refreshes automatically.

get.summary: Focus sessions started on a day

parameters.description: YYYY-MM-DD (default: today in the user's zone)
parameters.name: date

get.description: session is null when none is running. Sessions left running 60 min past their planned end are ended as abandoned.

put.description: The client makes the id (UUID); the same body sent again changes nothing. A new session gets the server's time as its start (or startedAt, for a start queued offline in the last 24 h). One running session per user.
put.summary: Start or update a focus session

put.description: Marks the user's local day closed with one win. Sending it again keeps the first close time.

get.description: Returns tasks for the authenticated user, optionally filtered by date

post.description: Creates a time block for the authenticated user
Creates multiple time blocks for the authenticated user

put.description: Replaces the blocks previously generated for that week (manual blocks are kept) in one transaction.
Partially updates a task (status, distractions, etc.)

post.description: Sets what happened in the block. Actual times default to the span of its completed focus sessions, else the planned times. Sending the same check-in again gives the same result.
post.summary: Check in a block (done / partial / skipped)

post.description: Atomically adds delta (1 or -1) to a block's distraction count, clamped to 0-100
Marks the block "moved" and creates a new planned block (movedFromId) at the new date/time. Needs an Idempotency-Key header (8-100 characters): a replay returns the first result.

get.description: Returns vocabulary words for the authenticated user with pagination and optional language filter
Returns 2 words for today (1 English C1-C2, 1 Russian A2+). Fetches from external API on first call of the day.

put.description: Toggles the learned flag for a vocabulary word
Toggles the saved flag for a vocabulary word

quote.example: Discipline is the bridge between goals and accomplishment.

madeAt.description: the device clock when the user saved the check-in; a check-in queued offline counts for that local day when the clock is believable (at most 24 h old, at most a minute ahead), otherwise for today

turnstileToken.description: TurnstileToken is required once the email has 3 failed logins in 15 minutes.
TurnstileToken is required on public registration (not on admin registration).

startedAt.description: only for a start queued offline

oldPassword.description: required to change email or password

sleepMinutes.description: real elapsed time, computed in the user's zone

startTime.description: kept until the TIME columns are dropped

BearerAuth.description: Enter your JWT token with the Bearer prefix: "Bearer <token>"
BearerAuth.name: Authorization
